name: Miura-Ori Fold
desc: A Miura-ori paper tessellation of parallelogram facets that perpetually actuates between flat and folded, its zigzag herringbone corrugation deepening and compressing as a raking light rakes the mountain and valley creases, rendered as kraft paper, blueprint crease diagram, metallic foil, concrete relief, or indigo washi.
